title: Brackenridge Nurses Home Expansion Awarded
summary:
*   **Hospital Expansion Approved:** City leaders greenlit a major expansion project for the Nurses' Home at Brackenridge Hospital.
*   **Lowest Bidder Selected:** After reviewing six proposals, the contract for the third-floor addition was awarded to J. B. Clardy Construction Company of Fort Worth for $57,960.00, based on their lowest bid and a positive recommendation from Fort Worth city officials.
*   **Boosting Healthcare Infrastructure:** This policy decision authorizes a vital upgrade, adding a new wing to the nurses' residence located at 705 East 14th Street.

We have endeavored to check the record of the Clardy Construction Company and have gotten
a very favorable report on them from the City of Fort Worth, where they are now
constructing a 500,000 gallon water storage tank. I also was advised by the Fort Worth
Director of Public Works that they have done several building jobs for Fort Worth and that
their work was entirely satisfactory.
In view of the above report, it is the recommendation of this department that the contract
for the Nurses Home Addition be awarded to the J. B. Clardy Construction Company for
$57.960.00.

Councilman Gillis then offered the following resolution, and moved its adoption:
(RESOLUTION)
BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: SECTION 1. THAT Walter E.
Seaholm, the Acting City Manager, be, and he is hereby, authorized and directed to execute
